title: Superpower button
description: Full pill buttons in a regular-weight grotesk. Solid is ink-coloured (near-black on white, white on the photo bands) and lightens on hover; brand is vermillion and warms to amber with a soft orange glow; glass is a frosted translucent pill for use over photos. 0.25s ease-out transitions.
notes: solid follows the foreground colour, so inside a .dark band it becomes a white pill with dark text
glass only reads over a photo or a dark surface
name: superpower-button

props.name: children
props.description: the label (an icon may come first)

props.name: href
props.description: where it goes; without it the button is a <button>

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: ink pill · brand: vermillion pill with a glow on hover · glass: frosted pill over photos

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 40px (header) · md: 46px · lg: 54px (the big membership CTA)

props.name: block
props.description: stretch to the width of its container

props.name: type
props.description: for a <button>: the form button type
